title: SearchPortal — Login SQL Injection Bypass
objective: The login form checks credentials with a hand-built SQL query. Log in as the admin account without ever knowing the admin password.

verifier.condition: The login query is manipulated so that the server authenticates the request as the admin account despite the admin's real password never being supplied.

credentials.label: Regular customer account
credentials.note: Use this to see the normal login flow first.

weakness: Login builds its SQL by string concatenation, so crafted credentials can authenticate as admin without the password.
seededData: SQLite: users table with an admin whose real password is never given; per-instance file.
solutionHint: The login query is built by gluing your username and password straight into a SQL string. What happens to the rest of the query if your username ends with a SQL comment marker?
